question: The star athlete Jwala Gutta is associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jwala Gutta** is a renowned** Indian badminton player** who has won several **medals and awards** in her career.
 
• She has represented India in numerous **international tournaments** and has brought laurels to the country.
 
• Jwala is known for her **exceptional skills and techniques** on the court, especially in doubles matches.
 
• She has also been a vocal advocate for the **development and promotion of badminton** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Table Tennis** is a popular indoor sport that involves **hitting a lightweight ball **back and forth across a table using small** paddles.**

 
 
• It is also a popular **Olympic sport.**
 
 
 
• **Squash** is a racket sport that involves **hitting a ball against a wall** in a closed court.
 
 
• It is also an **Olympic sport.**
 
 
 
• **Lawn Tennis** is a racket sport played on a **rectangular court **with a net across the middle.
 
 
• It is also an **Olympic sport.**
